description.zh:
是否执行强制删除。取值范围： 
         
- true：强制删除自定义镜像，忽略当前镜像是否被其他实例使用。
- false：正常删除自定义镜像，删除前检查当前镜像是否被其他实例使用。

默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to forcibly delete the custom image. Valid values:

- true: Forcibly deletes the custom image, ignoring whether the image is currently used by other instances.
- false: Normally deletes the custom image. Before deletion, the system checks whether the image is currently used by other instances.

Default value: false.

description.zh: 镜像ID。如果指定的自定义镜像不存在，则请求将被忽略。
description.en: The image ID. If the specified custom image does not exist, the request will be ignored.

description.zh: 自定义镜像所在的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the custom image. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

descriptions.zh: 对于不允许删除自定义镜像的情况以及镜像删除后的注意事项，请参见[删除自定义镜像](~~25466~~)。
descriptions.en: For scenarios where deleting a custom image is not allowed and precautions after an image is deleted, see [Delete a custom image](~~25466~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs delete-image --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --biz-force false --dry-run true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DeleteImage --region cn-hangzhou --Force false --ImageId 'm-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --DryRun true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
